title: The Spear of Vengeance | An in-depth Kalista Guide!
author: OtakuGaming

Morgana.summary: Her Black Shield can nullify your support's engage and much of your ult's value, and her binding heavily punishes you if you get caught while hopping forward aggressively.

Janna.summary: She is excellent at stopping the all-ins you want: her tornado, ult and speed boosts repeatedly break up your engages and separate you from your target.

Lulu.summary: Her polymorph, slows and shields punish your short-range aggression, and protecting her ADC makes it hard to finish kills with Rend.

Nami.summary: Her poke, sustain and CC make long trades uncomfortable, and her bubble is especially dangerous because you rely on constant movement in fights.

Brand.summary: His area damage punishes your predictable hopping, and one stun can stop your momentum and let his team burst you.

Ashe.summary: Her steady poke and slows make your hop-based trading hard, and her ult can catch you before you start stacking spears.

Zyra.summary: Her plants restrict your movement and punish extended trades, while her long-range poke and area CC make clean engages hard to find.

Velkoz.summary: His long range lets him harass you without giving you trades, and his CC and true-damage ult punish you in extended fights.

Xerath.summary: He pokes you from outside your trading range, and one misplaced hop into his long-range stun can lead to a devastating punish.

Soraka.summary: Her healing undoes the value of your short trades and Rend stacks, and her silence zone can stop your support's engage before an all-in completes.
